semantics: Preferred responsibility for requested deliverables, not a claim of exclusive model knowledge. Explicit domain analysis plus requested application code are separate jobs, including security analysis plus a patch/test. SQL and application code are also separately dispatched. A supplied formula/specification needs implementation only unless new domain analysis is requested.

code.description: Application code, functions, scripts, debugging, tests; includes implementation from a supplied specification/formula, not new domain analysis.

repo.description: Actual changes in an existing source-code repository/project, multi-file bug fixes and repository issues. Standalone functions/classes/methods, including the repository design pattern, use code.

sql.description: Design, write or explain relational SQL queries.

security.description: Security assessment, vulnerabilities, CWE classification, mitigation requirements. Separate requested executable patches/tests go to code.

iac.description: Security review and remediation of infrastructure/configuration as code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes deployment manifests and Helm charts, including IAM permissions, container privileges and public-access settings.

privacy.description: Identify PII, sensitive data and DLP risks.

finance.description: Financial analysis, valuation, finance formulas and calculations.

contract.description: Interpret and analyze contracts and clauses; no application-code implementation.

traffic_vn.description: Vietnamese traffic law using supplied legal evidence; not other countries.

medical.description: Medical and biomedical knowledge, educational clinical reasoning.

reasoning.description: Mathematics, logic and quantitative reasoning outside financial analysis.

verilog.description: Verilog, SystemVerilog, RTL, FPGA hardware descriptions, including their tests.

entities.description: Extract and normalize named entities from supplied text.

general_work: Non-specialist conversation, wording and presentation are handled by the final Thinker from the full original query. Return no specialist jobs when none are needed.
specialization_note: Do not rerank code into repo: the primary extractor distinguishes standalone methods from changes in an existing project. Rechecking this introduced false repo assignments.
